title: Klarna is now available in HubSpot's new Checkout experience for merchants in the U.S. and Canada | Klarna International
body_markdown:
**New York - September 9, 2026** - Klarna, the everyday finance network, today announced that businesses using HubSpot can now offer Klarna as a payment option to their customers at checkout. HubSpot serves more than 300,000 customers in more than 135 countries. Beginning today, qualified merchants in the U.S. and Canada using HubSpot payments or Stripe can now opt in to offer Klarna to their customers at checkout.


Over one in four Americans say they are more likely to complete a purchase when flexible payment options are available at checkout. By adding Klarna, HubSpot's network of growing small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) can now offer their customers Klarna’s full suite of payments options, including pay in full, pay in four interest-free installments and financing, without leaving the checkout flow.


"Consumers increasingly expect flexible ways to pay, no matter where they're shopping. Being one of the first payment options in HubSpot's new checkout puts Klarna directly in front of growing businesses at a pivotal moment. It gives them a real competitive edge, putting the same flexible payment options that consumers know and love into their hands, with no added complexity," said Lisa Robinson, Head of Partner Success, US East Coast and Canada at Klarna.


“Growing businesses shouldn’t have to choose between offering customers more ways to pay and keeping their operations simple. By bringing Klarna to HubSpot’s checkout experience, we’re helping merchants deliver the flexibility buyers expect while managing payments and customer relationships on one connected platform. That means less friction at checkout and more opportunities to turn buyer intent into revenue,” said Sarika Garg, Vice President and General Manager of Revenue Hub at HubSpot.


**About Klarna**


Klarna is the everyday finance network. With over 120 million global active Klarna users and 3.8 million transactions per day, Klarna’s AI-powered payments and commerce network is empowering people to pay smarter with a mission to be available everywhere for everything. Consumers can pay with Klarna online, in-store and through Apple Pay & Google Pay. Over 1.2 million retailers trust Klarna’s innovative solutions to drive growth and loyalty, including Uber, H&M, Saks, Sephora, Macy’s, Ikea, Expedia Group, Nike and Airbnb. Klarna is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: KLAR). For more information, visit


[Klarna.com](https://www.klarna.com/)
